name: antigravity-prompt-enhancer
description: Adds an Enhance Prompt button next to the Send button in Antigravity IDE while preserving @mentions and attachments, with self-healing IDE update protection.

commands.title: Prompt Enhancer: Reinstall / Repair IDE UI Hook

antigravityPromptEnhancer.proxyPort.description: Preferred loopback port for the local iframe proxy and enhance endpoint (falls back to an ephemeral port if busy). Overridden by AGY_ENHANCER_PORT.

antigravityPromptEnhancer.cliPath.description: Optional path to the native Antigravity CLI binary. Overridden by AGY_CLI_BIN.

antigravityPromptEnhancer.timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for running agy -p during prompt enhancement. Overridden by AGY_ENHANCER_TIMEOUT_MS.
